scope: delta-term hinge floor + curriculum schedule (within-run delta ramp-up)

spec_ref.framing_note: spec §4 defines delta as per-combo fixed hyperparam (LHS-9 sample). User pre2 prompt requests within-run curriculum schedule — this artifact stages curriculum framing as OPTIONAL EXTENSION for proposal to user (see §4 framing_clarification below)

loss_formula.expression: L = alpha * CE(text) + beta * MSE(tension) + gamma * MSE(BOLD) + delta * max(0, 5.0 - phi_star)

components.delta: phi_star hinge weight (curriculum-scheduled per this artifact)

curriculum_schedule.name: delta_ramp_up_3_phase
curriculum_schedule.rationale: early steps (5K) emphasize CE+MSE convergence; mid steps (25K) tighten phi preservation; late steps (50K) hard-floor enforcement

boundaries.intent: warm-up; loose phi floor while CE converges
phi preservation tightens as text quality stabilizes
hard-floor enforcement near end-of-budget; protect F2 verdict

curriculum_schedule.trigger_mechanism: step_count integer compared to boundary list; delta = max(boundary.delta where step >= boundary.step_start)
curriculum_schedule.checkpoint_resume_safe: step_count persisted in checkpoint dict; delta re-derived on resume from step_count

mock_loss_validation.verdict_mock: PASS_MOCK — boundary triggers fire at expected step counts; hinge zero above 5.0 floor; linear penalty below

framing_clarification.spec_doc_definition: spec §4 LHS-9 grid samples 9 distinct delta values per-combo (0.5, 1.0, 2.0 sub-set)
reconciliation_options: OPT_A: keep spec §4 (per-combo fixed) -- this artifact = optional override candidate, NOT default
OPT_B: amend spec §4 to within-run curriculum -- requires explicit user approval (spec doc edit)
OPT_C: hybrid -- run S3 sweep with per-combo fixed delta (spec default), then run 1 follow-up combo with within-run curriculum as comparison
framing_clarification.recommended: OPT_C (hybrid) — preserves spec §4 default + adds curriculum data point for next-cycle decision
framing_clarification.honest_caveat: spec §4 fixed-delta baseline must be measured first to validate curriculum gain

interaction_with_5_layer_mitigation.L1_baseline_lock: delta curriculum independent — baseline measured pre-train
interaction_with_5_layer_mitigation.L2_post_train_remeasure: delta curriculum measured at end (delta=2.0 phase active)
interaction_with_5_layer_mitigation.L4_lora_frozen_base_structural_bound: delta curriculum unaffected — base weights frozen regardless of delta
interaction_with_5_layer_mitigation.L5_ema_early_stop_phi_lt_10: delta curriculum compatible — early-stop triggers regardless of phase

infra_completeness.ema_state_compatibility: verified — EMA buffer untouched by delta change
infra_completeness.checkpoint_resume: step_count restored -> delta re-derived -> EMA buffer restored

honest_c3_caveats: curriculum boundaries (5K/25K/50K) are heuristic — no theoretical optimum derivation
OPT_A (spec default) and OPT_B (curriculum) Pareto comparison NOT performed; OPT_C hybrid recommended for evidence collection
delta=2.0 in late phase is 4x stronger than spec mid-grid (1.0) — may over-regularize and hurt CE; mitigation = L5 early-stop kicks in if phi reaches floor
within-run curriculum framing introduces additional hyperparam (boundary step counts) that itself is unswept — adds complexity
next_actions_for_exec: user decision: OPT_A (spec default) vs OPT_B (curriculum amendment) vs OPT_C (hybrid)
if OPT_C: assign 1 of 9 LHS combos to curriculum mode; compare F1-F4 verdict vs fixed-delta peers
if OPT_B: amend spec §4 with curriculum boundaries + new audit trail entry
wire delta-from-step-count helper into training loop
